_comment.fiction: Mike Malon and every example below are fictional demonstration data. Replace or remove them before preparing a real application.
_comment.schema_version: Keep 1 unless the application ships a schema migration.
_comment.fields: Legal name/contact fields must match the real candidate. Blank means unresolved. Reserved example.com addresses are demonstration contacts only.
_comment.documents: Paths identify reviewed local PDFs; replace them with paths readable on the machine that owns the browser. Database sharing does not copy PDFs.
_comment.education: One record per degree. Use school/degree/major exactly as awarded, GPA with its denominator, integer months 1-12 and four-digit years. Empty portal_values means no employer-specific spelling override.
_comment.languages: Candidate-confirmed language, native flag and proficiency. An empty list makes no claim.
_comment.work_experience: Add only supported employer, role, location, date and description records. Empty means none recorded.
_comment.projects: Describe actual work, contribution, tools, dates and evidence; remove fictional examples.
_comment.skills: Short labels supported by the evidence profile. Do not copy JD requirements as candidate abilities.
_comment.workday_checkbox_groups: Exact portal group labels and confirmed selected values; leave empty until inspected.
_comment.custom_answers: Exact question text maps to a confirmed answer. Keep legal, sponsorship and unknown answers null.
_comment.answer_rules: Narrow prompt rules with provenance; do not make broad rules for legal or sensitive questions.
_comment.voluntary_disclosures: Optional candidate choices; null means unresolved. accept_terms remains false until this application's terms are reviewed.
_comment.explicit_authorization: Confirmed work-authorization facts, location_scopes and company_consents. NYU enrollment does not establish nationality, immigration or work eligibility.
_comment.career_preferences: Candidate-specific location/role and resume-language preferences. Rendered PDF review should remain true.
_comment.personal_facts_confirmation: Dated provenance for additional real facts; use an empty object until confirmed.
_comment.safety: allow_sensitive_answers permits only already confirmed facts; allow_server_draft needs explicit draft scope and command; allow_submit must stay false.
